title: QAOA Parameter Transfer for Hypergraphs
summary: Variational Quantum Algorithms, including the Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), have shown promise in solving optimization problems but rely on costly variational loops that can themselves be hard optimization problems. Many methods have been proposed to mitigate this variational cost, with one of the most common being parameter transfer and concentration where variational parameters for one problem instance or for an average over problem instances can be used as a good set of parameters for another instance.
